scenario_or_breakage: CI and make lint will not run the new prompt-token guard, and make test-brainstorm-prompts will not exist

what: Planned Agent fallback collection relies on subagents writing deterministic output files, which conflicts with the existing Agent-tool pattern where inline Agent outputs are returned to the parent
scenario_or_breakage: When Cursor or Codex is unavailable, synthesis reads cursor-brainstorm-output.txt/codex-brainstorm-output.txt/claude-brainstorm-output.txt that may not exist or may not be authoritative, causing lost brainstorm output or false all-failed behavior
suggested_fix: Make the parent session capture each Agent return and Write it to the deterministic output path before synthesis; keep collect-agent-results.sh only for external Cursor/Codex outputs
